// RED fixture for `search-requires-acl-filter` — the lint MUST reject this.
// A search executes WITHOUT conjoining the list_objects ACL Filter before scoring: scoring then
// filtering leaks the existence and rank of forbidden documents (ADR-03, OQ-E).
pub async fn search_unfiltered(index: &Index, query: Query) -> Vec<Hit> {
    index.search(query).await.unwrap()
}
